comment: sumRange on the sweep jack is written with a volt spelling because that is the only spelling the field takes; the figure is in Hz. BEND sets the pitch envelope time constant as 0.015 / bend seconds (src/theKICK.cpp:511), so a larger number is a shorter fall. TONE maps to 40 * 500 raised to tone/10 Hz (src/theKICK.cpp:574). DRIVE gives the saturator a gain of 1 + fold*0.5, up to six times, normalised by tanh of that gain (src/theKICK.cpp:598-601). The accent is read only at the moment of a trigger, not continuously. The FM mode button has a VCVButton at its position but an opaque overlay is drawn on top of it (src/theKICK.cpp:750-782); mouse clicks reach the overlay, which cycles the mode on a left click and offers PM, RM, AM and SYNC by name on a right click, and does neither while no sample is loaded. The load strip and the mode overlay are plain widgets with no census position, so they are covered by a Note. The panel prints PITCH, SWEEP, BEND, FEEDBACK, DECAY, TONE, DRIVE, TRIG, ACCENT and OUT; the sample knob, the sample CV jack, the load strip and the mode lamp carry no lettering. Lettering is drawn in code at src/theKICK.cpp:1160-1183.
